resources.string: Show this plan to a parent or guardian before starting, and see a doctor immediately if you feel unwell, dizzy, or experience sharp pain during training.

8 weeks brings visible fitness, posture, and strength changes. Building a muscular physique takes months of consistent training, sleep, and home nutrition — Forge never promises overnight results in a fixed number of days.

End this session right now.

1. Put all weights down safely and sit down.
2. Drink water slowly and breathe calmly.
3. Tell a parent or adult in the house right away.
4. See a doctor if pain, dizziness, breathlessness, or discomfort continues.
You logged 2 or more skipped meals this week. Do not skip meals — eat on time to fuel study and recovery, and talk to a parent or doctor if eating feels difficult.
Your mood check-in has been low for two weeks in a row. Training can stay light — please talk openly with a parent, family member, or someone you trust.
Sunday is a locked recovery day. Only light walking and stretching are permitted — no extra strength training.
1/2 Sabzi or Salad • 1/4 Protein • 1/4 Rice or Roti (reduce usual rice by ~1/3)
